title: Customizing Your Site
excerpt: Discover how to customize HaruCMS to match your needs. From templates to styling, make HaruCMS work exactly the way you want.
content:
HaruCMS is designed to be flexible and customizable. There are many ways to tailor it to your specific needs.

Template System

The template system uses a simple, natural syntax that's easy to learn. Create beautiful layouts with loops, conditionals, and filters.

Styling

Customize the look and feel of your admin interface and frontend. The admin panel uses CSS variables for easy theming.

Extensibility

With the plugin system and custom fieldtypes, you can extend HaruCMS functionality to suit your specific requirements.
author: Admin
